lines.say: Skate or Die 2 wasn't just a sequel. It turned into a full adventure, with a paintball gun.
It came out in 1990, and this time E.A. made and published the NES version itself.
lines.cap: It came out in 1990, and this time EA made and published the NES version itself.

lines.say: You skate through the town of Elwood to rescue your girlfriend, C.J., from the gang leader, Icepick.
lines.cap: You skate through the town of Elwood to rescue your girlfriend, CJ, from the gang leader, Icepick.

lines.say: Your weapons? Paintballs, eggs, and firecrackers.
The goal is to build the ultimate half-pipe, called Double Trouble.
Fun fact: Rodney and Lester are back, and now they're on your side. Rodney sells boards, and Lester teaches tricks.
Did you ever beat it? Follow for more 8-Bit Backstory!
